description: One unsigned borrow from a line straight to a payee on its allowlist (or its owner): the line's agent or owner signs it, the USDG goes from Morpho to the payee, and the line owes it until repaid. Checked as the line checks it: the allowlist, a write-off, what is left of the daily limit today, the ceiling, the target LTV at today's price, the market's 90% and depth gate; simulated from the wallet. Check the transaction's to: a line the factory confirms (isAccount).

amount.description: USDG to pay, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

to.description: The payee: an address on the line's allowlist, or its owner

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: credit_pay
title: Prepare: pay from an agent credit line
